name: public_busy_days
viewQuery:
SELECT 
  appointments.id,
  appointments.appointment,
  users.company,
  appointments.client,
  is_visible,
  (CASE WHEN appointments.description LIKE '%[BLOCK]%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as is_blocked
FROM appointments
LEFT JOIN users ON users.id = appointments.user

name: portal_appointments
viewQuery:
SELECT
  id,
  created,
  updated,
  appointment,
  description,
  is_private,
  user,
  json_extract(client, '$[0]') as client_id
FROM appointments

name: public_doctors
viewQuery:
SELECT 
      contacts.id,
      contacts.salutation,
      contacts.company_name,
      contacts.name_first,
      contacts.name_last,
      contacts.street,
      contacts.housenr,
      contacts.zip,
      contacts.city,
      contacts.phone,
      contacts.email,
      contacts.notes
    FROM contacts
    WHERE (
      contacts.notes NOT LIKE '%"contact_type":"relative"%'
      AND contacts.notes NOT LIKE '%"contact_type":"caregiver"%'
      AND contacts.notes NOT LIKE '%Sohn%'
      AND contacts.notes NOT LIKE '%Tochter%'
      AND contacts.notes NOT LIKE '%Ehefrau%'
      AND contacts.notes NOT LIKE '%Neffe%'
      AND contacts.notes NOT LIKE '%Nichte%'
      AND contacts.notes NOT LIKE '%Erbe%'
    )
